proposal.observation: Phase-2 so far: capacity what-if rules (P0/P0c/P4b) already satisfied by the parent (0 violations), P2 closed (voltage-insensitive), prefix-drift failed (NA-E023/E024). Pre-check for the registered degradation law (loss.md §4.7, q_hat(n) = q_ref - (q_ref - q_eol)(n/y_hat)^b): on the 20 split-2021 training cells the law fits the real capacity trajectory to 1.2% of the fade budget when y_hat = true EOL (b median 1.05, range 0.85-1.25), but only to 5.4-6.3% with the parent's predicted EOL (prefixes 20/50/100) — the parent's EOL is not consistent with the cell's own fade law.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Adding the degradation-law loss (the predicted EOL must place the 0.8 crossing of a power-law fade curve that reproduces the cell's real capacity trajectory; train cells only, full trajectory) makes the predicted EOL physically consistent, lowering the law-fit error and not worsening val MAPE.
proposal.question_inherited: Which physics constraint does the parent actually break, and can a loss fix it?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Predicted EOL inconsistent with the fade law (law error 5-6% vs 1.2% achievable).
proposal.why_this_experiment: User 2026-11-09: Phase 2 must deliver a physics-informed loss (thesis contribution 1). The degradation law is registered (loss.md §4.7) and, unlike P0/P2, the parent measurably violates it.
proposal.modification: Loss = Relative Huber(0.15) + lambda * L_law, L_law = mean_k |q_hat(n_k) - q(n_k)| / (q_ref - q_eol) on K = 32 points of the smoothed (median-9) full train trajectory up to EOL, q_hat(n) = q_ref - (q_ref - q_eol)(n / y_hat)^b, y_hat = predicted EOL (cycles, gradient flows), b = softplus(law_head(summary)) + 0.3 (law head = Linear 97->1 on the NaFadeNet head input), q_ref = median q of cycles 1-10, q_eol = q at the label EOL; lambda = 0.5 * median grad-norm ratio (loss.md §5.2). Train cells only (.cache/qtraj_train_split2021_v1.pt).
proposal.changed_components: Objective only (adds the degradation-law term and its 98-parameter law head).
proposal.held_constant_components: NA-E009 model and config, split 2021, seed 2021, Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-5, batch 128, max 100 / min 5 epochs, patience 5, checkpoint rule, data, masks.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-2021 MAPE/RMSE/Acc@15 vs NA-E009 (0.0999 / 22.5 / 0.743); held-out val law-fit error (tools/law_fit_eval.py; evaluation only, val trajectories never used in training) vs the parent 0.0463 and the true-EOL floor 0.0161; balance band R median, active fraction, cosine (loss.md §5.3).
proposal.rejection_condition: DISCARD if split-2021 MAPE > 0.1049, or BALANCE_FAIL, or the excess held-out val law-fit error above the true-EOL floor does not fall by >= 30% (tools/law_fit_eval.py: parent NA-E009 0.0463, floor 0.0161 -> excess 0.0302; pass needs error <= 0.0372). Otherwise confirm on 42/2024 (parent 0.0348 / floor 0.0277; 0.0400 / 0.0152).
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; NaFadeNet block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.
